units.source_text: 许多青年侍女三三两两地在各处聚谈，互相诉说悲痛的心事。

en.t: Many young ladies-in-waiting gathered here and there in twos and threes, telling one another of the grief in their hearts.

units.source_text: 有人说：“公子说，只要我们都不走散，大家在此侍候小公子，便不会寂寥。

en.t: Someone said, "The lord said that as long as we do not scatter, and all stay here to serve the young master, he will not be lonely.

units.source_text: 然而这遗孤年纪太小了。”

en.t: But this orphaned child is far too young."

units.source_text: 也有人说：“我且回老家去，以后再来吧。”

en.t: Another said, "I will go back to my family home for now, and come again later."

units.source_text: 准备离去的侍女便互相惜别，各自诉说衷情，伤心之事，不可尽述。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting preparing to leave then bade one another sorrowful farewells, each speaking her innermost feelings; the sad scenes cannot all be told.
